description: Header file defining the CompositorNativeWindow11 class and RoHelper class for Windows UI Composition integration in ANGLE's D3D11 renderer, including methods for creating swap chains, handling Windows Runtime features, and managing visual surfaces.

classes.name: RoHelper
classes.description: Helper class for Windows Runtime operations such as string management, factory activation, and dispatcher queue control.

classes.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
classes.description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Windows.UI.Composition APIs for Direct3D 11 rendering with support for Win32 and WinRT.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the window with optional alpha transparency.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window and composition resources.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Checks if the window is minimized.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain for rendering.

methods.name: commitChange
methods.description: Commits visual changes to the composition surface.

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Static method to validate a native window handle.

methods.name: IsSupportedWinRelease
methods.description: Static method to check Windows release support.

methods.name: IsSpriteVisual
methods.description: Static method to determine if a window is a sprite visual.
